title: Warm Chewy Greek Egg Noodles
description: A comforting and satisfying Greek dish featuring chewy egg noodles in a rich render-fat sauce, perfect for a midnight craving. This nut-free friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the egg noodles to the pot and cook until they are slightly underdone.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the rendered pork fat in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Drain the noodles and add them to the saucepan with the render-fat mixture.
Toss the noodles in the render-fat mixture until they are well coated.
Stir in the grated feta cheese until it is melted and the noodles are well coated.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the noodles and serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
